summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude payments received by individuals as compensation for losses or damages from qualified wildfire disasters from their gross income, effective for amounts received after December 31, 2025, and before January 1, 2033.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude qualified wildfire relief payments from gross income, effectively lowering the tax burden for individuals receiving such payments. This is the primary purpose of the bill.

The bill creates a new tax exclusion (sec. 139M) for qualified wildfire relief payments, exempting them from gross income through 2032. This directly forgoes federal tax revenue with no offsetting revenue raisers or spending cuts, increasing the deficit to deliver the relief.
